title: Invisibility
answer: Invisibility is a innate toggle action with defence intent. Aspects: CONCEALMENT, MIND. Baseline potency 7, range 8.000, duration 600, energy 18, cooldown 0, residue 100, priority 10, and 2 generic presentation beats. Its standard signature uses the concealment motif, innate_concealment sound, and colours #6E7180 / #C27CFF.
